primary_selection: maximum validation specificity at recall >= 0.98; break ties by validation F1
justification: The existing deployed baseline's documented threshold was selected with validation recall above 0.98 (docs/evaluation_summary.md lines 16-18). Previous clean experiments used a stricter 0.99 constraint, so the primary v3 comparison matches the historical baseline policy.
reporting: Report both policies regardless of which has better legacy-test results. Use the 0.98 policy as primary; never choose a threshold by legacy-test optimization.
prior_test_exposure: The original benchmark and clean_v1/clean_v2 legacy-test outcomes have been inspected. Neither v3 operating policy is claimed to produce untouched external validation.
